note: Strategic paths and vendors under consideration. Nothing here is a recommendation until the evaluation is done.

paths.name: Renew or renegotiate GlobalWave (ruled out)
paths.summary: Ruled out at kickoff (D03). GlobalWave's promised new product is 12-18 months away, which is too late and too risky for our timeline.
for: Lowest delivery risk against the deadline
Gives a price baseline and leverage
against: Does not fix current pain points unless the product changes
No native link to the bank's new Abrigo risk rating (unverified)
paths.toLearn: Only whether a short extension of the current contract is possible as insurance.

paths.name: Replace with a new commercial LOS
paths.summary: Run a competitive selection and implement a new platform for commercial and small business lending by August 2028.
for: Chance to fix workflow and adoption issues
Room for automation as the bank grows to $5B
against: Needs integration work with COCC, LaserPro, Identifi
paths.toLearn: Verified integration references, real pricing, and implementation timelines from peer banks.

vendors.name: Global Wave Group, Credit Track (incumbent)
vendors.notes: Not a real option (D03). GlobalWave says a new solution is coming in 12-18 months, which does not meet our timeline.

vendors.name: Abrigo Lending & Credit Risk
vendors.notes: Seen at kickoff as promising and aligned with current relationships. Bank already uses Abrigo for risk rating. Needham Bank (~$7B, on COCC) is onboarding it now and is a reference lead. Integrations to COCC and LaserPro still need live references.

vendors.name: nCino Commercial Banking
vendors.notes: Seen at kickoff as powerful but costly, rigid, and historically hard for banks to fully adopt. Salesforce-based; admin burden is the open question.

vendors.name: Moody's Lending Suite (CreditLens)
vendors.notes: Now includes Numerated, which the bank uses today for small business lending.

vendors.name: Baker Hill NextGen
vendors.notes: Origination and portfolio risk platform with recent bank clients.

vendors.name: Teslar Software
vendors.notes: Lending workflow platform aimed at community banks.

vendors.name: Jack Henry Origination
vendors.notes: Mainly aimed at Jack Henry core clients. Check fit with COCC before investing time.

smallBusiness.name: Abrigo small business lending
smallBusiness.notes: Possible all-in-one option with the Abrigo LOS. Bank found Abrigo's lending platform (Sageworks) okay. Features unverified.

smallBusiness.name: Numerated
smallBusiness.notes: In use today (now owned by Moody's). Small business is in scope (D01); contract runs concurrently with GlobalWave. Contract terms needed (A12).

criteria.name: Fit for our deal mix
criteria.detail: Standard CRE and C&I at volume, plus the complex 10% of loans that carry 30% of dollars.

criteria.name: Integrations that work today
criteria.detail: COCC boarding, LaserPro, Identifi, Abrigo risk rating. Live references required.

criteria.name: Admin burden
criteria.detail: Can a part-time administrator run it without a developer?

criteria.name: CLO and PM usability
criteria.detail: Scored by the user panel during scripted demos.

criteria.name: Implementation timeline and risk
criteria.detail: Proven time to go-live at banks our size, and fit with the August 2028 target.

criteria.name: Total cost over 5 years
criteria.detail: Licensing, implementation, partner fees, internal staff, integrations.

criteria.name: Vendor strength and roadmap
criteria.detail: Financial health, ownership, customer base, product direction.

criteria.name: Reporting, covenants and ticklers
criteria.detail: Portfolio reporting, exception tracking, exam readiness.

vendorNote: Q2 PrecisionLender came up in research but is a loan pricing tool, not an origination system.
